title: Quackiiicraft
description: Enhances the classic Vanilla Minecraft experience with improved enchanting tables, stronger anvils, and useful quality-of-life tweaks — perfect for players who love the original but want more comfort and polish.
body:
This modpack for Minecraft Fabric 1.21.8. Enhances the Vanilla experience with subtle but meaningful improvements — all without breaking the original game's atmosphere.

The focus is on quality-of-life features and visual enhancements that make Minecraft feel more modern and enjoyable:

Visual upgrades such as smoother lighting, cleaner textures, and shader support

Quality-of-Life mods for better gameplay experience .

This pack is perfect for players who enjoy the core Minecraft gameplay but wish for a bit more comfort, performance, and visual fidelity — without straying far from the Vanilla feel.
